name: multiple_choice: Why is it useful to approximate the sampling distribution…
questionText: Why is it useful to approximate the sampling distribution of a statistical summary? Choose the best answer below.

choices.label: A
choices.text: The sampling distribution measures the repeatability of our answer in the presence of randomness, and therefore can be used to quantify our level of statistical uncertainty.

choices.label: B
choices.text: The sampling distribution can eliminate our uncertainty about how the results from a sample can be generalized to the wider population.

choices.label: C
choices.text: The sampling distribution is the variability in a measure that we observe in only one particular sample.

choices.label: D
choices.text: The sampling distribution can reduce our uncertainty about how the results from a sample can be generalized to the wider population.
